title: Wonder scores a $425 million partnership with DoorDash as it builds its food empire | TechCrunch
summary: Disrupt 2026: OpenAI, Anthropic, Replit, and more take over 6 industry stages. DoorDash will acquire Wonder’s Grubhub Campus Dining business (formerly Tapingo) for $300 million and will add $125 million to Wonder’s $650 million Series D round , announced in July.
